blocks.text: Camella introduces a new generation of forever homes with refined architecture, optimized layouts, and provisions for solar power integration, electric vehicle charging, and dual parking in select configurations. As Camella approaches its 50th year, the Philippines’ most trusted and preferred housing brand looks ahead with a new generation of forever homes shaped by how Filipino families live, lead, and leave a legacy of value. The product line strengthens the residential portfolio through optimized layouts, elevated specifications, and spaces suited to shifting lifestyle requirements. It advances Camella’s longstanding commitment to multigenerational living, translating nearly five decades of expertise into enclaves where Filipinos […]...
